mapper.select: select case when #{afterSaleVisible} then (select count(1) from mall_item_after_sale where status='PENDING_REVIEW') else 0 end pending_review, case when #{afterSaleVisible} then (select count(1) from mall_item_after_sale where status in ('APPROVED','RETURN_SHIPPED','REFUNDING')) else 0 end refund_pending, case when #{afterSaleVisible} then (select count(1) from mall_item_after_sale where status='FAILED') else 0 end refund_failed, case when #{financeVisible} then (select count(1) from mall_reconciliation_diff where status in ('OPEN','MANUAL')) else 0 end open_diffs, case when #{financeVisible} then (select count(1) from mall_reconciliation_alert where status='OPEN') else 0 end open_alerts, case when #{financeVisible} then (select count(1) from mall_compensation_task where status='MANUAL') else 0 end manual_compensations
mapper.sql: select 'AFTER_SALE' kind, after_sale_id record_id, after_sale_no business_no, order_no, coalesce(refund_amount,0) + coalesce(shipping_refund_amount,0) amount, status, case when status='FAILED' then 95 when risk_signal='MANUAL_REVIEW' then 85 when status='PENDING_REVIEW' then 80 when status in ('APPROVED','RETURN_SHIPPED','REFUNDING') then 70 else 30 end priority, risk_signal, update_time updated_at from mall_item_after_sale union all select 'DIFF' kind, diff_id record_id, diff_no business_no, order_no, coalesce(external_amount,local_amount) amount, status, case when diff_code='STATUS_AMOUNT_MISMATCH' then 92 else 75 end priority, diff_code risk_signal, update_time updated_at from mall_reconciliation_diff union all select 'ALERT' kind, a.alert_id record_id, a.alert_no business_no, d.order_no, coalesce(d.external_amount,d.local_amount) amount, a.status, case when a.alert_level='CRITICAL' then 100 when a.alert_level='HIGH' then 90 else 75 end priority, a.alert_level risk_signal, a.update_time updated_at from mall_reconciliation_alert a left join mall_reconciliation_diff d on d.diff_id=a.diff_id union all select 'COMPENSATION' kind, task_id record_id, task_no business_no, order_no, null amount, status, case when status='MANUAL' then 98 when status='FAILED' then 88 else 55 end priority, task_type risk_signal, update_time updated_at from mall_compensation_task

sql.where: and ((w.kind='AFTER_SALE' and #{afterSaleVisible}) or (w.kind in ('DIFF','ALERT','COMPENSATION') and #{financeVisible})) and w.kind='AFTER_SALE' and w.status='PENDING_REVIEW' and w.kind='AFTER_SALE' and w.status in ('APPROVED','RETURN_SHIPPED','REFUNDING','FAILED') and w.kind='DIFF' and w.kind='ALERT' and w.kind='COMPENSATION' and w.status=#{status} and w.business_no like concat('%',#{businessNo},'%') and w.order_no like concat('%',#{orderNo},'%') and w.updated_at >= #{from} and w.updated_at <= #{to}

mapper.select: select w.kind,w.record_id,w.business_no,w.order_no,w.amount,w.status,w.priority,w.risk_signal,w.updated_at from () w order by w.priority desc,w.updated_at desc,w.record_id desc
